decisive_items: strongly positive for vimentin and CD31
mass in the right atrium invading the right ventricle, superior vena cava, and inferior vena cava
response.rationale: CD31-positive malignant cells lining vascular spaces with cardiac invasion are diagnostic of angiosarcoma; choriocarcinoma and intravascular lymphoma require different markers, and metastatic disease is a nonspecific pattern of this angiosarcoma.

rejected.why: No trophoblastic or beta-hCG markers; CD31/vimentin favor endothelial malignancy.
CD31 is an endothelial marker, not a lymphoid marker; intravascular lymphoma would require lymphoid staining.
